# VAR-PLAN-0007: Annotation value is not a boolean

- Severity: warning
- Area: PLAN

## Description

An annotation that ingress-nginx reads as a boolean does not parse as one, so varco treats it as unset.

## Remediation

Set the annotation to a boolean value such as true or false, or remove it.
